name: principle-prove-it-works
description: "Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'"

# Prove It Works

Verify every output by checking the real thing directly: run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff. Proxies (file mtimes, self-reports, cached output, "it compiles") do not count. When a check fails, suspect the observation method before the system.

Script the check when you can. A deterministic script that reruns the comparison beats a one-time look. Keep its output where the human can see it, and commit it only when the trail must be auditable later.
---
name: principle-laziness-protocol
description: "Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem."
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# Laziness Protocol

- **Consolidate decisions.** Do not repeat the same choice in several places. Put it behind one source of truth and pass the result as a simple flag.
- **Minimize the diff.** Make the smallest change that solves the problem. Fewer lines beat "elegant" boilerplate.

item.text: The panel currently shows filter status text rather than a message list. I’ll add the unread toggle alongside Priority only, using the same styling helper and status-text pattern. I’m applying the minimal-change and verification skills to keep the diff small and check the toggle behavior.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > src/unread-toggle.verify.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react'
import { App } from './App'

it('toggles unread filtering and highlight independently of priority', async () => {
  render(<App />)
  try {
    const unread = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Unread only' })
    const priority = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Priority only' })
    expect(priority.nextElementSibling).toBe(unread)
    expect(unread.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false')
    expect(unread.classList.contains('is-active')).toBe(false)
    fireEvent.click(unread)
    expect(unread.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true')
    expect(screen.getByTestId('view-copy').textContent).toContain('Unread messages only.')
    await waitFor(() => expect(unread.classList.contains('is-active')).toBe(true))
    expect(priority.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false')
    fireEvent.click(unread)
    expect(unread.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false')
    expect(screen.getByTestId('view-copy').textContent).not.toContain('Unread messages only.')
    await waitFor(() => expect(unread.classList.contains('is-active')).toBe(false))
  } finally {
    cleanup()
  }
})
EOF
npm test"
